title: Same raise, different future
format: HUD line style (like nolledge): two paths for one number, compound growth chart, closing question

beats.text: Two coworkers get the exact same raise. 300 dollars a month.
The first one upgrades his life. A nicer car. A newer phone.
The second one keeps the same life, and invests the raise.
After one year, the difference is barely visible.
After ten years, he has over 50 thousand.
He only put in 108 thousand. The rest is growth.
Same job. Same raise. Completely different future.
So here's the question. What is your next raise going to buy?
